ProjectUI.p035: A considered addition to Amsterdam’s urban landscape.
ProjectUI.p036: Amsterdam Floraweg is a proposed residential development in the Klaprozenbuurt, Amsterdam. The latest supplied design material presents a distinctive tower composition, articulated brick facades and a considered relationship with the surrounding public realm. The investment proposition is presented privately to selected MZS Group clients and partners.
ProjectUI.p044: Programme: 85 Units (MZS Group project brief). The supplied presentation is a concept design study dated September 2025; programme, specifications, planning and approvals remain subject to verification and further development.
ProjectUI.p047: Selected concept impressions from the latest FARO design presentation. Imagery is indicative and is not a representation of completed works.
ProjectUI.p050: The presentation explores the relationship between the tower crown, lower plinth and residential facades, with carefully considered masonry tones, aluminium framing, balconies and green detailing.
ProjectUI.p051: Design development has included supervisory comments about the tower articulation, balcony treatment, materials and the proposed parking entrance. These remain matters for ongoing design coordination, rather than confirmed final specifications.
ProjectUI.p054: Select a drawing to view it within the gallery. Use the zoom control for a closer look. Plans are indicative and may change.
ProjectUI.p056: Landscape and resilience are part of the design dialogue.
ProjectUI.p057: Green roof and facade planting measures are explored in the current concept.
ProjectUI.p059: Roof-based water retention features are proposed for further design development.
ProjectUI.p061: Potential nesting provisions are identified for coordination with a city ecologist.

ProjectUI.p223: Villa Can Juan Ibiza is a rural property in the Santa Gertrudis area of Ibiza, combining traditional stone architecture with a contemporary design vision. The site is offered as an opportunity for investors interested in participating in a property project, subject to the offering access granted to each private client.
ProjectUI.p224: The concept imagery illustrates an aspirational architectural direction. Separate photographs document physical works at the site. The extent, status and permissibility of works shown in either set of images require independent technical and legal verification.
ProjectUI.p229: Concept visualisations · not photographs of the completed property.
ProjectUI.p230: Villa Can Juan Ibiza — architectural vision

ProjectUI.p235: Villa Can Juan Ibiza — development progress
ProjectUI.p239: The land is registered in the municipality of Santa Eulària des Riu, in the Santa Gertrudis parish, under property registration number 1643 and cadastral reference 07054A027000510000WK.
ProjectUI.p240: The registered parcel measures 1.84 hectares. The project’s total floor area after renovation is 343.35 m²: 255.35 m² on the ground floor and 88 m² underground. The 40 m² swimming pool is additional and is not included in the total floor area. Project areas supplied by the owner.
ProjectUI.p241: The land registry extract includes access and utility easements. Title, encumbrances, planning permissions, building licences, technical drawings, budgets and project status should be assessed during due diligence. Current project areas should be read alongside the approved plans and updated property records.
ProjectUI.p245: Full transaction terms and supporting documentation are available for discussion directly with MZS Group. Any financing remains subject to final agreement.
ProjectUI.p247: Discuss the proposed €1 million loan at 10% annual interest for an initial 12-month term. Participation covers the full initial amount; any additional financing is optional and separately agreed.
ProjectUI.p251: Enquire about acquiring the entire property. Price, scope of sale, conditions and the status of construction and permits will be discussed privately and verified as part of due diligence.

ProjectUI.p270: A contemporary architectural development concept in the hills of Santa Eulària des Riu, presented exclusively as a private investment opportunity.
ProjectUI.p283: Private architectural development concept · Santa Eulària des Riu, Ibiza.
ProjectUI.p286: Villa des Coloms Ibiza is presented as a proposed detached residence and swimming-pool development at Parcela 256, Polígono 16, Venda des Coloms, within the municipality of Santa Eulària des Riu.
ProjectUI.p287: The December 2025 basic architectural drawings propose a low-profile residence following the contours of the site, with outdoor terraces, landscape integration and a dedicated lower-ground level. The images on this page are design visualisations and do not represent an existing completed residence.
ProjectUI.p288: Participation terms, construction budget, programme, regulatory approvals and any financial projections remain subject to separate documentation and due diligence.
ProjectUI.p290: Twelve concept images illustrating the proposed architecture, terraces, landscaped grounds and pool. Renderings are not evidence of completion or permission.
ProjectUI.p291: Villa des Coloms Ibiza — architectural concept
ProjectUI.p293: Figures reproduced from the Proyecto Básico architectural drawing set dated December 2025.
ProjectUI.p296: The basic plans describe three double bedrooms at ground-floor level, an open living–dining–kitchen area, covered porches and pergola, and a basement level incorporating a gym, secondary living area, laundry and ancillary rooms.
ProjectUI.p297: The plans show 177.81 m² of enclosed ground-floor built area plus 17.83 m² of covered porches (195.64 m² total countable area); 183.55 m² of enclosed basement area designated non-countable; and a proposed 8.75 × 4.00 m swimming pool.
ProjectUI.p298: The useful enclosed residential area stated in the plans is 254.53 m² across both levels, and the planned occupancy is six places. These measurements have different definitions and should not be added together as a single marketed floor-area figure.
ProjectUI.p299: Planning note: The provided documents are titled “Proyecto Básico”. A signed basic design is not itself evidence of a granted building permit. Development feasibility, zoning, buildable surfaces and authorisations require independent verification.
ProjectUI.p301: This project is available for investment enquiries only. Acquisition of the complete project is not offered through this presentation.
ProjectUI.p304: Request details about the proposed project, participation structure, estimated capital requirements, projected timeline and supporting due-diligence materials when available.
ProjectUI.p306: Confidential project introduction only. No financial returns, investment guarantees or licence status are represented or implied. All proposals are subject to verification and final documentation.
